tags: Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service

agencies: Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service
data.abstract: On May 8, 2024, we published a final rule amending the horse protection regulations. The final rule was initially scheduled to go into effect on February 1, 2025, except for Sec. 11.19, which was effective on June 7, 2024. On January 28, 2025, we published a postponement of the effective date of the remaining provisions from February 1, 2025, to April 2, 2025. On March 21, 2025, we published a further delay of the effective date to February 1, 2026, and a request for comment on whether the length of the postponement should be extended. On January 28, 2026, based on developments following the issuance of the March 21, 2025, delay of effective date, we published a document further delaying the effective date of the final rule to December 31, 2026. On November 13, 2026, we published a proposed rule to remove parts of the 2024 Horse Protection final rule that were vacated by Court order from the regulations, as well as proposing to withdraw the non-vacated parts and update the regulations. As a consequence, in this document, we are issuing an extension of the postponement of the effective date of the final rule to December 31, 2027.

observations.title: Endangered Species; Recovery Permit Applications

data.abstract: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (We or Service) invites the public to comment on permit applications to conduct certain activities with listed species under the Endangered Species Act (ESA). With some exceptions, the ESA prohibits activities involving listed species unless the Service issues a federal authorization, such as a permit, to allow for such activities.
